prompt:
# TABLES
customers (4,000 rows; one row per customer)
  customer_id VARCHAR -- unique customer key, customer_city VARCHAR -- city of the customer, customer_region VARCHAR -- one of North/South/East/West/Central, signup_date DATE -- date the customer registered, acquisition_channel VARCHAR -- organic, paid_search, social, email, affiliate
sellers (180 rows; one row per seller (marketplace merchant)
response:
[
  "SELECT c.customer_region, p.product_category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status <> 'canceled' AND o.order_purchase_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_ts < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY c.customer_region, p.product_category",
  "SELECT c.customer_region, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status <> 'canceled' AND o.order_purchase_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_ts < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY c.customer_region, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_ts)",
  "SELECT p.product_category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status <> 'canceled' AND o.order_purchase_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_ts < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY p.product_category, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_ts)",
  "SELECT c.acquisition_channel, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status <> 'canceled' AND o.order_purchase_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_ts < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY c.acquisition_channel, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_ts)"
]
